Subject: Need help with a divorce by mutual consent case

Hello, my name is Aarti Mittal. I am a 25-year-old truck driver living in New Delhi. My spouse Venkat Sandhu and I want a divorce by mutual consent with a settlement of Rs 75,70,000, and the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned. My case number is Petition No. 2004/2024 in the Family Court at New Delhi. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 75814 10260 or email aarti.mittal@example.com.
